Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to the IIFL Finance Q2 FY '27 Earnings 
Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode, and there 
will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need

Vikas Jain: 
Yes. My name is Vikas Jain, CFO of IIFL Finance. Thank you very much, and a warm welcome 
to all the ladies and gentlemen who have joined us today for IIFL Finance Q2 FY '27 Investor 
Conference presentation call. Joining us on today's call are Mr. Nirmal Jain, our Founder and 
Managing Director; Mr. R. Venkataraman, our Co-Founder and Non-Executive Director; Mr. 
Girish Kousgi, CEO of IIFL Home Finance; and Mr. Venkatesh N, MD of IIFL Samasta Finance. 
 
During this call, we will take you through the company's performance for the second quarter and 
half year ended September 30, 2026. Before we discuss the detailed financial and operational 
performance, I would like to hand over the call to Mr. Nirmal Jain, who will share his perspective 
on the macroeconomic environment, key industry developments and the company's strategy and 
outlook. 
Nirmal Jain: 
Thank you, Vikas. Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us. So let's start with the 
macro environment. Macro backdrop remains very supportive of retail credit in India, but it is 
not without uncertainty. While domestic demand is steady, formal credit penetration in small 
towns and areas where we operate in is still very low. At the same time, global uncertainty, 
volatile oil prices or commodity prices and tight funding conditions means that balance sheet 
strength, asset quality, diversified funding and liquidity matter most than ever before. 
 
And in this environment, we have chosen to grow with discipline, keeping adequate liquidity 
and strict control on asset quality. Now to the quarter. So our AUM crossed INR1.24 lakh crores, 
which is a growth of 38% Y-o-Y and 8% sequentially Q-o-Q. Profit after tax on a consolidated 
basis was INR805 crores, first time crossing the milestone of INR800 crores, up 13% quarter-
on-quarter and 93% year-on-year. What is important is our gross NPA have improved and they 
remain at around 1.5%. Our return on equity now on a consolidated basis is above 20%, what 
has been our target. 
 
The book is about 90% secured now. And our liquidity is significantly higher than what normally 
we keep given the global environment and uncertainty as well as liquidity tightening expected 
in local market at INR13,805 crores on a group basis. Our capital adequacy on a computed basis 
is 23.5%, but we can discuss individual companies separately. 
 
So our strategy remains resilient capital-efficient growth and that's based on 6 pillars. One, 
secured lending as we have pivoted to secured lending, and that is already now 90% of our total 
AUM, and we will intend to endeavor to maintain it at these levels. 
 
Second is Capital-Light Growth. So our off-book AUM is 34% of our total loan assets. The 18 
banks that are active co-lending partners now, many of these relationships have started recently

our strategy remains digital because our goal that customer pledges with us has to be physically 
stored in aggregate, including gold loans, microfinance, we have more than 5,000 branches now. 
And primarily serving underserved customers across the country. 
 
Sixth is our credit and cost discipline. As you'll see in our numbers that we are trying to make 
sure that our credit cost and the operating costs move southward in relation to our loan assets 
and which will help us strengthen our balance sheet further. Looking ahead, we are confident 
that this momentum will continue through FY '27 and will remain disciplined on asset quality 
and capital. Thank you.

momentum, improved profitability, continued progress towards our building a secured and 
capital-efficient portfolio. We remain conscious on the significant portion of recent growth has 
come from the gold loans. Capital adequacy, liquidity portfolio concentration and risk control, 
therefore, remains an important area of focus. 
 
Coming to the consolidated financial performance. At a consolidated level, our loan AUM 
increased to INR1,24,268 crores, representing the growth 8% quarter-on-quarter and 38% year-

90% of our AUM. Gold loans represent around 53% of our portfolio and while Home loan 
accounts for around approximately 27%. Consolidated net interest income increased to 13%

pre-provision operating profit increased to 8% to INR1,355 crores.

the INR800 crores milestone. And on a half yearly basis, it stood at around INR1,518 crores.

to INR894 crores.

quarter basis to INR548.5 crores. The stand-alone yield has increased by 12 basis points to 
18.6%, while the spread increased by 11 basis points to 9.2%. Operating expense to average 
AUM has moderated further to 3.1%. Stand-alone gross NPA stood at 1.3%, representing a 
modest increase by 3 basis points. Capital adequacy ratio stood at 17.03%, while net gearing 
increased to 4.7x. 
 
Gold loans now account for almost around 93% of our stand-alone AUM. On IIFL Home 
Finance performance, the AUM increased by 4% sequentially crossing INR43,070 crores, while 
disbursement grew by 10% on a quarter-on-quarter basis to INR3,498 crores. PPOP increased 
6% sequentially to INR330 crores. PAT has broadly stable at INR188.7 crores. Gross NPA has 
improved by 8 basis points to 1.38%. 
 
At Samasta Finance, AUM has remained stable at INR10,816 crores and business maintained a 
calibrated approach to growth. Gross NPA has improved by 46 basis points to 2.82%. Net NPA
